objections.challenge: Could trial history be mislabeled as internal memory?
objections.stage_a_response_under_challenge: No: internal belief/posterior is separated from external observed reward history.

objections.challenge: Could experimenter-defined coupling alternatives be mistaken for learned internal structure itself?
objections.stage_a_response_under_challenge: No: alternatives are world/task hypotheses; posterior probability over them is internal state.

objections.challenge: Could Q-learning comparator be folded into central structure-learning mechanism?
Could posterior predictive value be treated as a separate persistent coordinator?
objections.stage_a_response_under_challenge: No: it is computed/read from belief state.

objections.challenge: Were omitted temporal dependencies and fit failures retained?
objections.stage_a_response_under_challenge: Yes: both are explicit Stage A negative evidence.
